LanguageData.TMM_MinutemenReliefQuest_Description: Minutemen militiamen and monster hunters report a recent assault by mutated beasts against an outlying patrol. Their field supplies are depleted. They ask your colony to deliver humanitarian relief consisting of {0}x {1}.\n\nFulfilling this request will strengthen alliance ties with the faction and unlock coordinates to their field research archives.
LanguageData.TMM_MinutemenArchiveQuest_Title: Field Archive of the Abandoned Post
LanguageData.TMM_MinutemenArchiveQuest_Description: Minutemen command has shared coordinates of a fortified listening post abandoned after an encounter with anomalous entities. The archive chamber contains a valuable field data core detailing protective warding circles and beast vulnerabilities.\n\nSend an expedition to the outpost, secure the archive chamber, and bring the field archive safely back to your colony.
